question: ₹87,400 were divided among A, B and C, such that 4 times the share of A = 9 times the share of B = 3 times the share of C. Find the share of A
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the cover-up (hide-and-multiply) method for 4A = 9B = 3C:

A = 9 × 3 = 27, B = 4 × 3 = 12, C = 4 × 9 = 36

Ratio A : B : C = 27 : 12 : 36 = 9 : 4 : 12

Total parts = 9 + 4 + 12 = 25 parts

A's share = (9 ÷ 25) × 87400 = 9 × 3496 = ₹31,464

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31,464.**
